body: Integer received early termination of the HSR waiting period for its $127-per-share acquisition by an affiliate of KKR.Key Highlights:HSR waiting period for the proposed KKR acquisition of Integer terminated early, satisfying one closing condition.Acquirer will pay $127 per share in cash, implying an enterprise value of ~ $5.7 billion.Transaction remains subject to Integer stockholder approval and other regulatory and customary closing conditions.Special meeting of stockholders to vote on the merger is scheduled for October 21, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. CT.Board unanimously recommends stockholders vote “FOR” the merger agreement and related proposals.Original SEC Filing: Integer Holdings Corp [ ITGR ] - 8-K - Sep. 30, 2026DisclaimerThis is an AI-powered summary.
